annotation.title_en: Guidelines (Personal Information Protection Commission, Korea – guidelines listing)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC), Republic of Korea
annotation.summary_en: Index page of Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission listing four English-translated guidelines: pseudonymizing unstructured data (2024), biometric information protection (2022), an AI personal information protection self-checklist (2021), and supplementary rules for data transferred to Korea (2021). No substantive guideline text and no embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Lists guideline on pseudonymizing unstructured data (2024.11.14)
Lists AI personal information protection self-checklist (2021.07.09)
Lists supplementary PIPA rules for personal data transferred to Korea (2021.02.09)
English translations are unofficial; Korean versions prevail
